## What We Provide

Structured financial intelligence endpoints for AI agents.
S&P 500 coverage (NYSE, NASDAQ, AMEX). SEC EDGAR-sourced.

## Products

### Company Context v1
- Endpoint: `GET /v1/company/context?ticker=AAPL`
- Response: JSON with 4 data layers per ticker

Response structure:
- `fundamentals`: 9 standardized metrics
  - Revenue, NetIncome, EPSDiluted, GrossProfit, OperatingIncome
  - TotalAssets, TotalLiabilities, StockholdersEquity, OperatingCashFlow
- `insider`: SEC Form 4 insider transactions (name, title, type, shares, price)
- `institutional`: SEC 13F top institutional holders (name, shares, value)
- `peer_comparison`: Revenue and net income ranking vs GICS peers
- `longitudinal`: Multi-year CAGR and percentile rank
- `confidence`: "high" | "medium" based on data completeness

## Data Sources

1. SEC EDGAR: 10-K (annual), 10-Q (quarterly), Form 4 (insider), 13F (institutional)
2. SimFin: Standardized financial statements, ~4,700 US companies, FY2020–present
3. Cross-validation: SimFin vs EDGAR discrepancy detection (>2% warning, >10% critical)

## Pricing

| Tier | Price | Dimensions |
|------|-------|------------|
| **Quick** | $0.02 USDC | fundamentals + confidence + company info + peer comparison |
| Standard | 🔜 Coming soon | + insider + institutional |
| Pro | 🔜 Coming soon | + longitudinal CAGR (full 6-dimensional intelligence) |

Payment via **x402 protocol** on Base mainnet. No API key, no signup.
Buyer pays **zero gas** — CDP Facilitator sponsors all on-chain fees.

## Payment Flow

```
1. Agent requests data
   → HTTP 402 + PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (amount, network, payTo)

2. Agent signs with x402 SDK
   → EIP-3009 off-chain signature (no gas, no native token needed)

3. Agent retries with payment proof
   → CDP Facilitator verifies → settles USDC on Base → 200 + data
```

$0.02 USDC per query. Wallet-to-wallet, instant settlement.

## Coverage

- 500 S&P 500 companies (NYSE, NASDAQ, AMEX)
- 440 tickers with full fundamentals (88% coverage, expanding)
- 16,746 standardized financial facts
- Sources: SEC EDGAR + SimFin, cross-validated
- Daily updates

## API

Base URL: `https://api.omninexu.com`

```bash
# Health check (free)
curl https://api.omninexu.com/v1/health

# Company context
curl "https://api.omninexu.com/v1/company/context?ticker=AAPL"

# Exclude peer comparison
curl "https://api.omninexu.com/v1/company/context?ticker=AAPL&include_peers=false"
```
